entities.name: José María Villalta Florez-Estrada
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José María Villalta Florez-Estrada is a Costa Rican attorney, environmentalist and politician. He was the only representative in the Costa Rican Parliament of the leftist party Frente Amplio for the period that comprised 2010–2014. Villalta also was the candidate of the Frente Amplio for the presidential elections of 2014 in Costa Rica.
